effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 Digimon may gain ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of your opponent's turn. Then, if DigiXrosing, reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 of each [Gokuumon], [Sagomon], [Cho-Hakkaimon] and [Shakamon] among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, return 1 yellow Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the hand.

xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -2] [Gokuumon] or [Sagomon] or [Cho-Hakkaimon]
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
